question: How do I place an order?
answer: Browse our catalogue, add items to your cart, then click 'Checkout'. Enter your shipping address, choose a payment method and confirm. You'll get an order confirmation email within a few minutes.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Go to 'My Account' > 'Orders' and click 'Track' next to your order. You can also use the tracking link in your shipping confirmation email.
variants: What is the status of my order?

question: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Yes, you can cancel an order from 'My Account' > 'Orders' as long as it hasn't shipped yet. Once it has shipped, you'll need to return it instead.

question: Can I change or modify my order after placing it?
answer: You can change the shipping address or remove items while the order status is 'Processing'. Once it moves to 'Packed' or 'Shipped', changes are no longer possible.

question: Why was my order cancelled?
answer: Orders are occasionally cancelled when payment verification fails, an item goes out of stock, or the address can't be validated. We email you the reason and refund any amount charged within 5-7 business days.

question: I received the wrong item or an item is missing from my order. What should I do?
answer: Sorry about that! Contact support within 7 days of delivery with your order number and a photo of what you received. We'll ship the correct or missing item at no cost.

question: Do you offer bulk or business orders?
answer: Yes. For orders of 10+ units or business invoicing, email business@voltcart.example and our B2B team will send you a quote within one business day.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days, Express takes 1-2 business days, and Same-Day delivery is available in select cities for orders placed before 12 PM.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50; otherwise it's $4.99. Express shipping costs $12.99 and Same-Day delivery costs $19.99.

question: Do you ship internationally?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery takes 7-14 business days, and customs duties or import taxes are paid by the recipient.

question: Can I change my shipping address?
answer: You can update the shipping address from 'My Account' > 'Orders' while the order is still 'Processing'. After it ships, contact the courier using your tracking link.

question: My package says delivered but I haven't received it. What should I do?
answer: Check with neighbours and your building's reception first, then wait 24 hours as couriers sometimes mark packages early. If it still hasn't arrived, contact support and we'll open an investigation with the courier.
variants: Tracking says delivered but the package never came
My order is marked as delivered but it's not here
It says delivered but I never got my package

question: Can I pick up my order from a store?
answer: Yes. Choose 'Click & Collect' at checkout and select a store. You'll get an email when your order is ready, usually within 2 hours; bring a photo ID to collect it.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return most items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as they are in their original condition and packaging. Opened software, earphones and personal care items can't be returned for hygiene and licensing reasons.

question: How do I return an item?
answer: Go to 'My Account' > 'Orders', select the item and click 'Return'. Print the prepaid label, pack the item securely and drop it at any courier point, or schedule a free pickup.

question: How long does it take to get a refund?
answer: Once we receive and inspect your return (usually 2-3 days), the refund is issued to your original payment method. Banks typically take another 5-7 business days to show it.

question: Can I exchange an item for a different one?
answer: Yes. Start a return and choose 'Exchange' as the reason, then pick the replacement item. If the new item costs more, you'll pay the difference; if less, we refund it.

question: Do I have to pay for return shipping?
answer: No, returns are free for all domestic orders. International customers pay return shipping unless the item arrived damaged or defective.

question: What if my product arrived damaged or defective?
answer: Report it within 7 days of delivery with photos via 'My Account' > 'Orders' > 'Report a problem'. We'll send a free replacement or give you a full refund, your choice.
variants: The item I received is broken
My new device doesn't work out of the box

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay and store gift cards. Cash on delivery is available for orders under $500.

question: Is it safe to use my credit card on your website?
answer: Yes. All payments are processed over encrypted HTTPS connections by a PCI-DSS compliant payment provider. We never store your full card number.

question: Do you offer EMI or buy now pay later options?
answer: Yes. Orders over $200 qualify for 3, 6 or 12-month instalment plans with partner banks, and we also support Klarna for pay-later purchases. Choose the option at checkout.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Payments are usually declined because of incorrect card details, insufficient funds, or a bank security check. Double-check your details, contact your bank, or try a different payment method.

question: I was charged twice for the same order. What should I do?
answer: Duplicate charges are usually temporary authorisation holds that disappear within 3-5 business days. If both charges still show after that, contact support with your order number and we'll refund the extra charge.

question: How do I use a discount code or gift card?
answer: Enter your discount code or gift card number in the 'Promo code / Gift card' box on the checkout page and click 'Apply'. Only one discount code can be used per order.

question: Do your products come with a warranty?
answer: Yes. All new products come with the manufacturer's warranty, usually 1 year. The exact period is listed on each product page under 'Warranty'.

question: How do I make a warranty claim?
answer: Go to 'My Account' > 'Orders', select the product and click 'Warranty claim'. Describe the issue and upload your invoice; we'll arrange a pickup or direct you to the nearest authorised service centre.

question: Can I buy an extended warranty?
answer: Yes. VoltCare Extended Protection adds 1 or 2 extra years of coverage and can be added at checkout or within 30 days of purchase from 'My Account' > 'Orders'.

question: Does the warranty cover accidental damage?
answer: The standard manufacturer warranty covers only manufacturing defects. Accidental damage such as drops or liquid spills is covered only if you purchased VoltCare Accidental Damage Protection.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click 'Sign up' at the top of any page and register with your email address or Google account. You can also create an account during checkout.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: Click 'Log in' and then 'Forgot password?'. Enter your registered email and we'll send you a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.

question: How do I update my email address or phone number?
answer: Log in and go to 'My Account' > 'Profile', then click 'Edit' next to your email or phone number. We'll send a verification code to confirm the change.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to 'My Account' > 'Privacy' and click 'Delete account'. Your account and personal data are permanently removed within 30 days, except records we must keep for legal or tax purposes.

question: How do I unsubscribe from promotional emails?
answer: Click 'Unsubscribe' at the bottom of any promotional email, or turn off marketing emails in 'My Account' > 'Notifications'. You'll still receive order and shipping updates.
